label: rem:confinement-phase-stratification-interpretation
title: Topology of the confinement locus $\Omega(P)$
html: For simple particles, \Omega(P) forms a single connected interval of \mathcal{G} containing q_0. For composite particles with multi-block binding, \Omega(P) can be disconnected. Each component corresponds to a distinct configuration of the active support. We physically realise transitions between components as chemical or nuclear rearrangements. Computationally, they appear as regime switches in the witness files.
